chunks.text: Inspection Report Approval Procedure (SOP-107): every field inspection report must be reviewed against applicable company procedures before an approval note is issued. The reviewer verifies the recorded findings, the supporting evidence, and the measured conditions stated in the report.

Approval note requirements: summarize the inspection, list key findings with their supporting evidence, reference the applicable procedure section, state a recommended action, and record the reviewer decision. Any information missing from the source must be marked Not available in source material.

Draft approval notes are prepared by the workbench and must not be treated as final approval. A human reviewer with approval authority must approve, reject, or request correction before any follow-up action is taken on the report.

Evidence standard: each finding must cite the source report and, where available, a section or page reference. Findings without supporting evidence require re-inspection before approval. Status labels used in review: Not Started, In Progress, Completed, Blocked, Requires Review.
